options.a: Evaluates a string as live PowerShell code — PS's eval
No — it was removed in PS7; use Get-CimInstance instead

questions.prompt: What's the significance of the registry path ...\CurrentVersion\Run?

options.a: Autostart persistence — values there run automatically at boot/logon (T1547.001)
options.b: It stores the current user's password hash

questions.prompt: Does a PowerShell switch statement fall through to the next condition?

options.a: Yes — no implicit break, unlike C/Java switch
options.b: No — it stops after the first match, like C/Java
